call_input.prompt:
Create exactly ONE finished, independent, flat product launch poster for the assigned P02 direction. Portrait aspect ratio exactly 4:5. This is a fresh original, with no reference images. The coordinator manages the user's total two-image set; this call produces one poster only. Use case: ads-marketing.

Full user request and mandatory conditions:
덕테이프 포스터로 가상의 접이식 컵 출시 포스터를 만들어줘.
총 2장이고 두 장 모두 세로 4:5야. 실물 촬영 같은 제품 사진이 들어가야 해.
제품은 손잡이가 없는 350mL 컵으로, 몸체는 짙은 녹색 실리콘이고 뚜껑은 반투명 흰색이야.
실제 브랜드나 로고를 쓰지 말고 제품 표면에는 글자를 넣지 마.
아래 표시 문구를 그대로 사용해줘.
FOLN
Fold Cup
가볍게 접고, 다시 펼치다
350 mL · 접이식 실리콘 컵
2026.12.01 RELEASE
온라인 사전 주문 11.10–11.30
foln.example/store

Visual idea: the cup becomes small enough to carry in a jacket pocket. Make a convincing real editorial product photograph of an unbranded pale cool-gray everyday jacket lying loosely, cropped beyond the frame, with its genuine pocket opening and a single compact collapsed dark forest-green silicone cup partially slipped into that pocket. No hands, no person, no bag. The cup is handleless, round, and visibly a collapsed accordion drinking vessel: a broad circular lid, a continuous silicone body with several coherent telescoped folds, and a shallow compressed depth, not an ordinary rigid storage box. Show enough of the cup above the pocket to understand its green collapsible wall and its round form. The milky translucent white lid sits naturally and snugly on the matching rim; subtle light transmission, no opaque chalky lid, no added spout, handle or text. The lower cup is occluded naturally by the front pocket lip, with contact shadow and plausible scale. A high, gently oblique close photograph makes the circular lid an ellipse and keeps the cup-wall folds clear. This is a photograph within the single flat poster, not a photographed printed poster or device mockup.

Composition and typography: treat the pocket opening, the product-name block and the cup's shallow height as one spatial arrangement. Let the pocket enter from the right half and continue diagonally toward the lower-left, while the cup above it anchors the upper-right of that seam. Use the photographic pale jacket surface as the unified poster field, with controlled broad cloth folds and clear margins. Place FOLN at upper-left as a restrained but plainly readable brand name, and make Fold Cup the strongest verbal identification immediately below it, broad and substantial with natural English glyph proportions and an open word space. It must remain identifiable at a 320px-long-side thumbnail; do not let FOLN swallow the product name. The Fold Cup block and the pocket opening share their width and scale relationship: the title ends before the cup's near contour, with an unmistakable generous gap, so no accidental text/product tangent occurs. Keep the complete Korean promise close to the product name, on one horizontal line if it comfortably fits. Allocate sufficient width for full natural Hangul shapes and generous internal counters; do not horizontally squeeze Korean or English. The small words are never ornamental microtype.

The descriptive capacity/material line is an adjacent bridge beneath the main photo subject. At the lower-left, make release, preorder and store URL a deliberate three-line semantic group, with enough real area and comfortable line spacing, not a tiny bottom strip. The long preorder line and entire URL must be easy to read at an actual 720px-wide view. Keep all seven supplied strings exactly once, preserving casing, spaces, punctuation, middle dot and the en dash. All characters are crisp coherent print typography with warm near-black / deep-green ink contrast against the jacket field, using compatible sans-serif Korean and Latin optical weight. No decorative labels, arbitrary rules, iconography, invented marks or supplementary copy.

Photographic finish: directional soft daylight from upper-left, natural shadows in the pocket recess, coherent highlights on the lid, muted matte silicone with smoother broad surfaces and local detail only where the fold curvature needs it. The jacket has real seams and a restrained woven material texture, varying with focus, scale and light. Do not coat jacket, lid and silicone with the same dense uniform texture. The pocket lip, collapsed rings, lid/body joint and cast shadow must remain physically separate, consistent and clean; no fused or melted rims. The cup surface is completely blank. No actual brand, logo, watermark, price, certification, performance claim, false microtext or extra product. The scene should make the carrying state understandable without adding explanatory text.

요청한 화면 비율을 유지하면서 현재 도구와 모델이 지원하는 가능한 최대 해상도로 출력
